Alternatives scored: manual_level_ride_before_compression=0.86, low_mid_corrective_cut=0.85, high_pass_cleanup=0.82, vocal_plosive_dynamic_hpf_control=0.72. Alternative tradeoffs: manual_level_ride_before_compression: lower_speed,precision_score;total_score_delta=0.048 (WING OSC not_a_console_mutation); low_mid_corrective_cut: lower_reversibility,safety_score;total_score_delta=0.063 (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); high_pass_cleanup: lower_musical,reversibility_score;total_score_delta=0.094 (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); vocal_plosive_dynamic_hpf_control: live_plosive_review_priority:hpf_change_can_thin_vocal_mid_show (WING OSC native_channel_gate_deq_dynamic_eq_osc_path_templates_declared). Selected WING OSC: Behringer WING Rack fw3.0.5 not_a_console_mutation; native_supported=False; status=analysis_only_no_console_write; live_write=False. Selected readback paths: none for analysis-only/no-console-write strategy. Selected readback status: analysis_only_no_console_write. Parameters: {'dsp_change': 'hold_or_manual_mic_technique', 'operator_action': 'check_pop_filter_mic_distance_and_angle', 'plosive_risk_score': 0.82, 'live_plosive_review_priority': True, 'required_context': 'operator_audition_pop_filter_mic_distance_previous_hpf_readback', 'forbidden_without_wing_proof': 'dynamic_hpf_static_hpf'}. Remaining blockers: none. Operator check: Ask the singer to check plosive technique if DSP starts thinning the vocal. Rollback/readback is required before any live promotion.

alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Sibilance evidence is stronger than broad harshness; de-essing is narrower.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check consonants and air; do not remove intelligibility.
alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: WING-native channel EQ can safely reduce the measured sibilance band when the narrower de-esser path has no verified OSC mapping.

alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Vocal dynamics need phrase leveling that preserves words and consonants; a source-tuned leveler is more precise than a generic channel compressor.
